items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: And I was very fortunate that he took a liking to me and brought me in and sort of directed — well not directed — but sort of gave me the privilege to explore my playing.

ctx.x: He was my guru man. He was my everything. He did, as far as I’m concerned, he did it all. And I was very fortunate that he took a liking to me and brought me in and sort of directed — well not directed — but sort of gave me the privilege to explore my playing. He helped me to develop what I was trying to do. Because he saw what I was trying to do. And he just put me in a position to develop it. And he told me that, because Miles Davis did the same thing for him. He saw the potential in Coltrane and he put him in…
Was there other things besides just the music that you gained from him also?
